source_metadata.title: The Five-Year Prospective Study of Quality of Life in Hemifacial Spasm Treated with Abo-Botulinum Toxin A

duplicate_review.notes: Repeated abstract/conclusion statements were not duplicated when they represented the same source assertion; figure-level annual analyses were retained when analytically distinct from three-month sequential analyses.

consistency_findings: Page 2 reports “HFS 30” = 15.9 ± 2.3 after 45 months (p=0.008) immediately after an AIMS sentence; the value and figure context appear AIMS-like, but the source label was preserved without correction.
Figure 4 caption uses overlapping/ambiguous labels for physical-health-related and physical-functioning panels; the caption-level result was preserved with a source_figure_label_ambiguity tag.
The study describes 74 participants as included in analysis but does not report visit-specific denominators or attrition by timepoint.
extraction_limitations: Background claims attributed to prior literature were not converted into primary-study result atoms.
The current model has no dedicated field for standard errors; reported ±SE values are preserved in canonical statements and original_result_text.
The current quantitative schema has no native longitudinal trajectory object, so timepoints are represented with arm labels while keeping the original text.
Clinical resistance was reported qualitatively; the source does not describe a formal resistance definition, antibody assay, or dedicated resistance measurement method.

No dedicated adverse-event results table or systematic safety ascertainment was reported; the discussion-level “without serious complications” claim was retained as an author conclusion rather than an adverse_event atom.
schema_gaps: No structured standard-error field in QuantitativeResult or ArmObservation.
No dedicated source-typographical-inconsistency object; inconsistencies are preserved with tags and validation notes.
